description: Rename a project by copying every file from <userid>/<from>/ to <userid>/<to>/ and deleting the originals. Refuses to merge into an existing project — `to` must not exist yet. Object tags (publish state, etc.) are preserved.

to.description: New project name (must not already exist; cannot be "*")

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_rename_project
